fragments.text: I am anxious because of my deeds, I worry constantly, I fear on the day of judgment, when I come for remembrance.
I seek out the Merciful, I entreat the Compassionate, I implore Him who has appointed this day for me for remembrance.
When I come in judgment, on whom shall I rely, who will find righteousness for me as a remembrance?
Upon the fathers I put my trust, I derive benefit from their work, they have from of old served as my remembrance.
My arm was strong when Moses pleaded to be wiped out, so that my name should not be wiped out nor should my remembrance.
Should a man stand before the Lord, can he then help me, when merit is required from me for remembrance.
I rejoiced with him (Aaron) who wore the Ephod and the Breast-plate of Judgment on which my name was engraved for remembrance.
He hastened with his censor until the plague had abated, when a stranger (Korah) approached to act as priest, the flames devoured him as a remembrance.
Behold, O God, when I stand before Thee, there is no man in my midst whom I could designate for remembrance.
Can anyone pray and turn
back anger (like Pinhas),then let his name be inscribed for future generations as a remembrance.
Who is it that hates gain that he might say: “Testify against me”, and the Lord Himself replied as a witness for remembrance.
With a sucking lamb he (Samuel) atoned for us and, equal to the noble pair of brothers (Moses and Aaron), he rises for remembrance.
When he saw the wrath of the Lord, he (David) said: “Let Thy hand turn against me”, that he conformed to the will of his God is his remembrance.
He cried out and caused the angel’s sword to return to its sheath, therefore was his throne established as firmly as the sun for remembrance.
At the time of drought I wait for Him who releases and brings rain (Elijah), who restored breath to the child already lost to remembrance.
He lives on as a witness at circumcisions because he spoke of his zeal when the people had abandoned both covenant and remembrance.
Formerly I had one who could atone before the Lord, when he brought the meal-offering as a bribe for remembrance.
Gifts of nard and spices perfumed His chambers, blood and fat as a delight and the show-bread for remembrance.
I was placed like an empty vessel upon the coals, that Israel may not be widowed, I plead
for remembrance.
O Lord, in Thee do I trust and not in princes, for they are in the grave and Thy Name is for ever for remembrance.
All these supported me but I seek Thy compassion, without it I should have perished and not survived for remembrance.
For in spite of their strength, they could not plead for me before Thee, those in whose mouths is Thy greatness have placed it there for remembrance.
For this day has been stored the sum of assessments, it is the beginning of days and the first for remembrance.
On it there is read out what was engraved with a diamond quill, what was revealed and explained and known in remembrance.
Death and life, peace and war, dearth and abundance, appear for remembrance.
The acts of man, the number of his steps, though forgotten by men, they are to God for remembrance.
“My way is hidden” — who could say that? In vain was a sin inscribed for me for remembrance.
In front of man his deeds give evidence, his falsehood bears witness against him for remembrance.
Proclaim the plans of the Lord, all men together, pass under the staff like a flock for remembrance.
The Lord closes the door on behalf of the flawless during
the storm until their destiny arrives and they go forth for remembrance.
As it is written in Thy Torah:
‘God remembered Noah and all the beasts and all the cattle that were with him in the ark and God caused a wind to pass over the earth and the waters subsided’.
Perform wonders for the living lest they become like the dead; is then Thy truth in the grave for remembrance?
Once Thou didst pity because of noble deeds; pity us now even though we are without deeds; wilt Thou not make for Thy wonders a remembrance.
As it is written in Thy holy words:
‘A memorial has He made for His wonders, gracious and compassionate is the Lord’.
And it was said:
‘He gave food to those that fear Him, He will remember His covenant for ever’.
Turn, O God, to those who sit in the gardens (houses of study), listen how they speak of Thy law for remembrance.
Let their work appear before Thee; though they eat the bread of anguish, their reward is with Thee in the book of remembrance.
As it is written through Thy prophet:
‘Then those who fear God speak one to the other and God listens and hears, and it is inscribed in the book of remembrance before Him on behalf of those who fear the Lord and respect His Name’.
The foxes (Egyptians), the destroyers of vineyards, planned to cut off from the vine its root and remembrance.
They oppressed them (Israel) with hardship, they cried out to Thee and were saved because of the piety of the forefathers who had been inscribed for remembrance.
As it is written in Thy Torah:
‘God heard their cry, then God remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob’.
In days of old Thou didst see generations in whom there was no delight. Thou hast let them vanish and perish without a remembrance.
One generation hast Thou chosen from among a thousand and allotted them Thy words; for their sake in every generation hast Thou engraved them for remembrance.
As it is written in Thy holy words:
‘He remembers for ever His covenant, the word He commanded for a thousand generations’.
The Exalted One took great delight in the youthful bride (Israel); her slain and her afflicted hast Thou set for remembrance.
She ran behind Thee in the dry and dark valley, the love of her betrothal wilt Thou make for a remembrance.
As it was written through Thy prophet:

‘Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem saying: ‘Thus says the Lord: I remember unto you the grace of your youth, the love of your betrothal, when you followed Me in the wilderness, in land unsown!’.
This people became corrupt and bore the insults of its enemies, a powerless idol did they set up as a remembrance.
They were almost annihilated had not Moses stood in the breach, recalling the oath and the covenant for remembrance.
As it is written in Thy Torah:

‘Remember Abraham, Isaac and Israel, Thy servants to whom Thou didst swear by Thyself and to whom Thou didst speak: I will multiply Thy seed like the stars of the heavens, and all this land of which I have spoken, I will give to your seed that they may inherit it for ever’.
Thou hast from of old rejected the assembly of peoples, in us hast Thou found delight as testimony for
remembrance.

Instead of the despised silver (of Israel in the time of Jeremiah) Thou didst choose the forgotten generation (of Israel in Babylon); acquire us once again for we have been forgotten from remembrance.
As it is written in Thy holy writings:
‘Remember Thy cogregation whom Thou didst acquire in days of old, the tribe whom Thou didst redeem as Thy inheritance, this Mount of Zion upon which Thou didst dwell’.
He examined the flawless (Jacob), after whom his seed was to be called, he intertwined his hands as a sign and remembrance.
Be tender with Ephraim who was likened to a delightful child and a dear son; is he not my firstborn whom Thou hast inscribed for remembrance.
